candidates.name: Offline status-word inspector
candidates.benefit: Show the raw packed status and its inputs while preserving unconfirmed bit meanings.
constraints: Do not normalize raw source bytes or callee values to Boolean fields.
Do not infer seat or driving behavior without separate evidence.

candidates.name: Offline callback-record viewer
candidates.benefit: Trace tag AB/BA/B9 and the shared callback through actual CODE providers.
constraints: Do not assume bytes3/10/11 of the length12 record were initialized.
ROM buffer lifetime and scheduling units remain unproved.
